links.tradeoff: The medically fine-tuned variant produced many more invalid responses, which is a new failure mode.
links.quote: Overall, 88.4% (6110/6912) of responses were valid, with the o3 model producing the highest validity rate (2273/2304, 98.6%), followed by LLaVA (2108/2304, 91.5%) and LLaVA-Med (1729/2304, 75%; P<.001).

links.outcome: Nodule margin assessment accuracy in LLaVA models
links.quote: Labeled images improved accuracy marginally in nodule margin assessment only when evaluating LLaVA models (407/768, 53% to 447/768, 58.2%; P=.04).
